title: 2030 — First mesh hulls cloud instances rent mycelium mats logic by the

First mesh hulls cloud instances rent mycelium mats logic by the hour to researchers worldwide.

What must be true first: the mycelium mats results have to replicate outside the lab, mesh logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and electrical readout operations need a year of continuous runtime. title: Fungal Computing Meshes Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Fungal Computing Meshes operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Fungal Computing Meshes installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 85223 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where mycelium mats monitoring, mesh logistics redundancy, or electrical readout maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Fungal Computing Meshes Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Fungal Computing Meshes: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Fungal Computing Meshes — mycelium networks processing information.

Phase 1 — Prove (mycelium mats): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (mesh logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (electrical readout): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (growth control): mesh hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and labs-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
